   If your phone na Android, turn on **Data Saver** (go Settings > Network & Internet > Data Saver). If you dey browse with Chrome, turn on **Lite mode** so pages go load faster and use less data.

3. **Always connect Wi-Fi when e dey available**
   Before you download heavy files or watch video, check if Wi-Fi dey house, office or shop. Make you dey use Wi-Fi instead of mobile data. And when you dey sleep or no dey use your phone, **turn off mobile data** completely – background apps dey secretly use data even when you no know.
